info.name: Flock Safety API Platform (v3) Alerts API

description.content:
Flock Safety v3 API Platform harvested from the public developer hub (docs.flocksafety.com). Combines the Device, Custom Hotlist, LPR Search, Plate Lookup, Hotlist Alerts Subscription, Geolocation, CAD, Inbound Alerts, and Vehicle Detections Ingest APIs. OAuth2 client_credentials (machine) and authorization_code (user) flows against api.flocksafety.com.

Contact Support:
 Name: Flock Safety Developer Hub
